contracts.name: TransformPlateCornerForcesToMemberLocal
contracts.summary: Transforms an owned global plate-corner packet into a described managed member basis.
contracts.remarks: Projects global corner forces and moments into a managed member basis at the same corner point. It does not reverse member-end signs, transfer moments, sum adjacent plates or return native analytical-member result forces. Beam overloads use supplied beta degrees and require the corner to match a supplied member end ID and point; node-direction overloads use zero beta and no fabricated native member ID. Projected global Y defines the reference except near vertical, where projected global Z is used. This convention is not native orientation read-back. This overload is pure managed math over an existing packet and performs no native result query.
contracts.sourceSignature: MemberForces TransformPlateCornerForcesToMemberLocal(PlateCornerForces plateCornerForces, Node otherMemberNode)
contracts.signature: OutputQueryResult<PlateCornerMemberForces> TransformPlateCornerForcesToMemberLocal(PlateCornerForces plateCornerForces, Node otherMemberNode)

contracts.name: TransformPlateCornerForcesToMemberLocal
contracts.summary: Projects an ordered collection of owned corner packets without native result calls.
contracts.remarks: Projects global corner forces and moments into a managed member basis at the same corner point. It does not reverse member-end signs, transfer moments, sum adjacent plates or return native analytical-member result forces. Beam overloads use supplied beta degrees and require the corner to match a supplied member end ID and point; node-direction overloads use zero beta and no fabricated native member ID. Projected global Y defines the reference except near vertical, where projected global Z is used. This convention is not native orientation read-back. Unlike sparse extraction, this preserves duplicate source observations and performs no hydration or COM result query. Every source packet is validated before a result collection is returned.
contracts.signature: OutputBatchResult<PlateCornerMemberForces> TransformPlateCornerForcesToMemberLocal(IEnumerable<PlateCornerForces> plateCornerForces, Beam member)
